Construction documents for sites that are covered development projects as defined in section 24-541 of the administrative code shall comply with section 28-104.11.1 through 28-104.11.4.
(L.L. 2017/097, 5/30/2017, eff. 6/1/2019; Am. L.L. 2020/091, 9/27/2020, eff. 3/26/2021)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2020/091.
